mainEntity.name: How much does a website for a local business cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most small business websites cost between $300 and $1,500 depending on design, content, and features. Northway Web offers a professional one-page website for $399 with no long-term contracts or hidden fees.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most websites are completed within 72 hours after business details are provided. This allows local service businesses to get online quickly and start receiving customer inquiries sooner.

mainEntity.name: What types of businesses do you build websites for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Northway Web builds websites for local service businesses such as plumbers, electricians, HVAC companies, cleaners, salons, auto repair shops, and similar service providers.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with businesses outside of North America?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. While many clients are based in North America, Northway Web also works with businesses internationally. Websites are designed to perform well regardless of location.

mainEntity.name: Do I need ongoing website maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ongoing maintenance is optional. Some businesses choose basic hosting, security updates, and backups to keep their website fast and secure. Monthly care plans are available but not required.

mainEntity.name: Will my website work on mobile phones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every website built by Northway Web is fully mobile-friendly to ensure customers can easily view the site and contact the business from their phones.

mainEntity.name: Can my website help me get more customer inquiries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Websites are designed to clearly explain services, build trust, and make it easy for customers to contact the business using forms and click-to-call features.

mainEntity.name: Do I need technical knowledge to manage my website?

acceptedAnswer.text: No technical knowledge is required. Northway Web handles the technical setup, and optional ongoing care includes updates and basic edits.

mainEntity.name: Is there a contract or long-term commitment?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Website builds are one-time payments, and monthly care services are optional and can be canceled at any time.

mainEntity.name: What information do you need to get started?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get started, Northway Web typically needs the business name, services offered, contact details, and any existing branding such as a logo. Guidance is provided throughout the process.
